edges.notes: Virtio drivers and core infrastructure are part of the Linux kernel tree per kernel virtio documentation.
KVM guests commonly use virtio devices for paravirtual I/O; virtio is the device model, KVM is the hypervisor API.
Firecracker exposes virtio block and network devices to guests; virtio is the interface, Firecracker is the VMM.
vhost accelerates virtio virtqueue handling on the host; virtio defines the guest/device contract.
QEMU supplies virtio device models for guests; virtio is the contract, QEMU is the VMM.
